policy_rows.selected: {"consequence":"A proposed schedule gives volunteers a common starting point.","decision":"How should volunteers find a working session they can attend?","mechanism":"The coordinator places possible garden sessions on the calendar before volunteers choose available times."}

{"consequence":"A complete initial allocation can be corrected by the people doing the work.","decision":"How should unclaimed routine work be allocated?","mechanism":"The coordinator proposes task assignments on the work board, then volunteers exchange unsuitable tasks."}

{"consequence":"Handover times respond to actual waiting users.","decision":"How should shared tools move between volunteers?","mechanism":"Volunteers request shared tools on the tool list, and current users agree on return times with them."}

{"consequence":"Assignments follow a shared account of current need.","decision":"How should watering observations lead to assigned work?","mechanism":"Volunteers inspect beds and post observations before anyone claims watering work from the board."}

{"consequence":"Most care periods follow volunteered availability.","decision":"How should volunteers choose who tends young seedlings?","mechanism":"Volunteers choose seedling care periods on the roster, and the coordinator fills any gaps afterward."}

{"consequence":"Practice begins independently with a later correction opportunity.","decision":"How should an unfamiliar volunteer learn a routine task?","mechanism":"The newcomer reads the task card, tries the activity, and then asks the experienced volunteer to check."}

{"consequence":"Harvest portions are arranged around actual collection availability.","decision":"How should harvest offers be matched to available collectors?","mechanism":"Neighbors state collection times before garden volunteers divide harvest quantities among those times."}

{"consequence":"A shared plan grows from connections between concrete suggestions.","decision":"How should ideas for a communal bed be compared?","mechanism":"Members bring one bed idea and its purpose to the meeting, then combine compatible proposals."}

{"consequence":"An explicit two-person structure makes incomplete sessions visible.","decision":"How should compost-turning sessions be organized?","mechanism":"The coordinator posts paired compost work periods and invites volunteers to claim either place."}

{"consequence":"Conditions across the garden can be compared at one visit.","decision":"How should garden observations be kept useful?","mechanism":"Volunteers keep a page for each date and list the beds observed that day."}

{"consequence":"Maintenance can avoid the periods when a path is busiest.","decision":"How should path maintenance respond to visitor use?","mechanism":"Volunteers observe visitor use before choosing path-maintenance times."}

{"consequence":"Demand and allocation are settled in one discussion.","decision":"How should shared material requests be combined?","mechanism":"Volunteers jointly review activities and material quantities before adding a combined request to the list."}

{"consequence":"Temporary help follows the gardeners’ stated needs.","decision":"How should an unused shared plot receive temporary care?","mechanism":"The usual gardeners list welcome care tasks before other volunteers choose temporary assignments."}

{"consequence":"The map supports self-guided orientation with optional help.","decision":"How should new visitors understand the shared spaces?","mechanism":"Visitors use the garden map first and ask the host about any unclear shared spaces."}

{"consequence":"The work change follows the announced absence.","decision":"How should volunteers announce a change in their plans?","mechanism":"Volunteers update their calendar attendance and then mark affected tasks on the board."}

{"consequence":"A new idea is tested against conditions and available participation.","decision":"How should the garden choose its next seasonal priority?","mechanism":"Members propose a seasonal priority during discussion and check it against both sets of records."}
